$comment: RTI workflow documentation. Edit this file to add/remove flows or nodes; the page reloads it via fetch(). IDs in flow steps must match a package id below. A step's ref is 'path · symbol' (no line numbers, which rot); RTITests/WorkflowDocTests checks every path and symbol.

Start, pause, stop and finish; owns the in-memory live transcript.

flows.title: Start a recording session
flows.summary: Hotkey or menu → SessionCoordinator opens the recording legs → both legs stream PCM to hosted Soniox → words become live transcript entries held in memory.

steps.label: hotkey dispatch
steps.passes: Carbon RegisterEventHotKey fires; the coordinator finds the command by keyCode + modifiers and runs its action.

steps.label: toggleSession()
steps.passes: The Start/Finish command calls the SessionCoordinator singleton.

steps.label: prepare(recordingDirectory:)
steps.passes: After mic permission resolves, launchSession opens the durable recording legs in the new session folder and the mic STT client.

steps.label: open(in:)
steps.passes: The per-leg WAV files open in the session folder; they are the only audio copy.

steps.label: start tap
steps.passes: AVAudioEngine input tap delivers 16 kHz mono PCM buffers.

steps.label: connect + sendAudio
steps.passes: Opens the hosted Soniox WebSocket and sends PCM as binary frames. The system leg joins about 8 s later on its own socket.

steps.label: onWords
steps.passes: Parsed tokens (interim is_final=false, final is_final=true) reach the coordinator through AudioPipeline.

steps.label: process(words:channel:)
steps.passes: Words aggregate into live entries per channel (mic → self, system → remote speakers). Nothing is written to disk until the checkpoint or stop.

flows.title: Finish a session
flows.summary: Finish → audio legs close → the session folder is written to the vault → Soniox re-transcribes the retained audio → the summary is written → the vault router and meeting processor run.

steps.label: finish()
steps.passes: After the stop flush, completeStop closes the legs and releases the mic.

steps.label: archive()
steps.passes: A snapshot of transcript, chat, analysis and audio URLs is archived.

steps.label: write(...)
steps.passes: transcript.md, chat.md, notes and the WAV legs land in <vault>/…/rti/sessions/<stamp>/.

steps.label: upgrade(sessionDirectory:)
steps.passes: The automatic Soniox file pass runs over the retained legs; a pending marker survives a quit.

steps.label: upgrade(sessionDir:)
steps.passes: The legs merge with the system-audio offset; transcript.md is backed up and replaced.

steps.label: writeAutoSummary
steps.passes: summary.md and title.txt are generated from the upgraded text.

steps.label: runVaultRouter / runMeetingProcessor
steps.passes: Vault-side routing and the /meeting processor are handed the finished folder.

flows.title: Upgrade a saved transcript
flows.summary: Sessions browser → Upgrade Transcript → confirm → Soniox file pass over the retained audio → transcript and summary replaced (backups kept). At launch, AppDelegate resumes any upgrade a quit interrupted.

steps.label: upgrade(session:provider:)
steps.passes: The confirmed row's session folder is upgraded with Soniox; progress shows in the row notice.

steps.label: upgrade(sessionDir:)
steps.passes: The provider script runs per leg; both pipes are drained so it cannot block.

steps.label: writeAutoSummary
steps.passes: The summary is regenerated from the upgraded transcript.

steps.label: resume pending upgrades
steps.passes: At launch, sessions with an automatic-upgrade marker are found off the main thread and upgraded in order.

flows.title: Smart Screenshot (⌘⇧H)
flows.summary: Hotkey captures the screens, runs OCR on this Mac, and attaches the text and image to the composer for the next turn.

steps.label: ⌘⇧H pressed
steps.passes: The Smart Screenshot command fires.

steps.label: captureAndAttach()
steps.passes: The command starts a capture that excludes RTI and deny-listed windows.

steps.label: recognizeText(in:)
steps.passes: Apple Vision reads the captured image on this Mac.

steps.label: attachScreenContext
steps.passes: OCR text and the JPEG become pending context in the composer.

flows.title: Ask the assistant (⌘\)
flows.summary: The overlay opens → the user asks → AssistantTurnBuilder assembles mode, sources and recent transcript → ToolLoop streams SSE from the active provider, running tools such as search_vault between rounds.

steps.label: toggleOverlay()
steps.passes: The overlay command shows or hides the window.

steps.label: toggle()
steps.passes: The titled overlay window orders front.

steps.label: sendAskAnything
steps.passes: The composer text and attachments start a turn.

steps.label: build
steps.passes: The turn's messages, route and tool policy are built.

steps.label: buildSystemMessages
steps.passes: System and conversation messages are assembled.

steps.label: run
steps.passes: The loop streams the answer and runs tool calls between rounds.

steps.label: streamWithTools
steps.passes: Each round is one streaming request.

steps.label: stream
steps.passes: SSE deltas and reasoning stream back to the controller.

steps.label: execute
steps.passes: A tool call runs under the turn's policy.

steps.label: search_vault
steps.passes: Vault search runs through the CLI.

steps.label: searchOutcome
steps.passes: bun runs the vault-search CLI against the Neon index.

flows.title: Switch active mode
flows.summary: The user picks a Mode in Settings → ModeStore updates → the next turn builds its system prompt from that mode.

steps.label: activeModeId = id
steps.passes: The Modes pane sets the active mode.

steps.label: activeMode on the next turn
steps.passes: The controller reads the active mode when it builds a turn.

steps.label: build with the mode
steps.passes: The mode's prompt and reference text enter the system messages.

flows.title: Change LLM provider / API key
flows.summary: The Providers pane writes keys to CredentialStore and the active provider id; the next request reads both on demand.

steps.label: setValue(_:for:)
steps.passes: Keys are saved to the owner-only credentials file.

steps.label: activeId = id
steps.passes: The selected assistant provider becomes active.

steps.label: active
steps.passes: Each request resolves the active provider's base URL and model.

steps.label: apiKey closure
steps.passes: The provider's key is read at request time.
